import cv2,numpy as np
c=cv2.VideoCapture('example_video.mp4')
fs=[]
while True:
  r,f=c.read()
  if not r:break
  fs.append(f)
sm=[cv2.resize(fs[i][150:540,150:960],(405,195)) for i in range(52,80)]
for i,s in zip(range(52,80),sm): cv2.putText(s,str(i),(5,20),0,0.7,(0,0,255),2)
rows=[np.hstack(sm[j:j+4]) for j in range(0,28,4)]
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/fr/m2.jpg',np.vstack(rows))
"
